title: Sci-Fi Combat HUD Concept Sheet
summary: Sci-fi HUD concept sheet for health, shields, ammo, abilities, minimap, and tactical overlays.
prompt: Design a sci-fi combat HUD concept sheet for {argument name="game_title" default="Orbital Breach"}. Include player health, shield, ammo, ability cooldowns, target lock, minimap, squad command wheel, objective tracker, damage direction, status effects, and low-health feedback. Show normal, critical, stealth, and boss states. Prioritize combat clarity, ultrawide safety, and controller-friendly hierarchy.
